verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs describe Queries as live, auto-updating questions over the knowledge base: you define criteria and the Query assembles results as a View. The GitHub repo lists database and kanban blocks alongside custom Types, objects carry Properties, and community comments confirm database/table use. missing for 10: explicit documentation that query criteria filter on structured properties, an explicitly documented list/table view-type switcher on query results, independent hands-on corroboration of live views beyond brief community mentions.
